easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
